you will break them with an iron scepter;
you will smash them like a potter’s jar.’”
Psalm 2:10:
so now, you kings, do what is wise;
you rulers of the earth, submit to correction.
Psalm 2:11:
serve the lord in fear.
repent in terror.
Psalm 2:12:
give sincere homage.
otherwise he will be angry,
and you will die because of your behavior,
when his anger quickly ignites.
how blessed are all who take shelter in him!
Psalm 3:1:
lord, how numerous are my enemies!
many attack me.
Psalm 3:2:
many say about me,
“god will not deliver him.” (selah)
Psalm 3:3:
but you, lord, are a shield that protects me;
you are my glory and the one who restores me.
Psalm 3:4:
to the lord i cried out,
and he answered me from his holy hill. (selah)
Psalm 3:5:
i rested and slept;
i awoke, for the lord protects me.
Psalm 3:6:
i am not afraid of the multitude of people
who attack me from all directions.
Psalm 3:7:
rise up, lord!
deliver me, my god!
yes, you will strike all my enemies on the jaw;
you will break the teeth of the wicked.
Psalm 3:8:
the lord delivers;
you show favor to your people. (selah)
Psalm 4:1:
when i call out, answer me,
o god who vindicates me.
though i am hemmed in, you will lead me into a wide, open place.
have mercy on me and respond to my prayer.
Psalm 4:2:
you men, how long will you try to turn my honor into shame?
how long will you love what is worthless
and search for what is deceptive? (selah)
Psalm 4:3:
realize that the lord shows the godly special favor;
the lord responds when i cry out to him.
Psalm 4:4:
tremble with fear and do not sin.
meditate as you lie in bed, and repent of your ways. (selah)
Psalm 4:5:
offer the prescribed sacrifices
and trust in the lord.
Psalm 4:6:
many say, “who can show us anything good?”
smile upon us, lord!
Psalm 4:7:
you make me happier
than those who have abundant grain and wine.
Psalm 4:8:
i will lie down and sleep peacefully,
for you, lord, make me safe and secure.
Psalm 5:1:
listen to what i say, lord!
carefully consider my complaint!
Psalm 5:2:
pay attention to my cry for help,
my king and my god,
for i am praying to you!
Psalm 5:3:
lord, in the morning you will hear me;
in the morning i will present my case to you and then wait expectantly for an answer.
Psalm 5:4:
certainly you are not a god who approves of evil;
evil people cannot dwell with you.
Psalm 5:5:
arrogant people cannot stand in your presence;
you hate all who behave wickedly.
Psalm 5:6:
you destroy liars;
the lord despises violent and deceitful people.
Psalm 5:7:
but as for me, because of your great faithfulness i will enter your house;
i will bow down toward your holy temple as i worship you.
Psalm 5:8:
lord, lead me in your righteousness
because of those who wait to ambush me,
remove the obstacles in the way in which you are guiding me.
Psalm 5:9:
for they do not speak the truth;
their stomachs are like the place of destruction,
their throats like an open grave,
their tongues like a steep slope leading into it.
Psalm 5:10:
condemn them, o god!
may their own schemes be their downfall.
drive them away because of their many acts of insurrection,
for they have rebelled against you.
Psalm 5:11:
but may all who take shelter in you be happy.
may they continually shout for joy.
shelter them so that those who are loyal to you may rejoice.
Psalm 5:12:
certainly you reward the godly, lord.
like a shield you protect them in your good favor.
Psalm 6:1:
lord, do not rebuke me in your anger.
do not discipline me in your raging fury.
Psalm 6:2:
have mercy on me, lord, for i am frail.
heal me, lord, for my bones are shaking.
Psalm 6:3:
i am absolutely terrified,
and you, lord—how long will this continue?
Psalm 6:4:
relent, lord, rescue me!
deliver me because of your faithfulness.
Psalm 6:5:
for no one remembers you in the realm of death.
in sheol who gives you thanks?
Psalm 6:7:
my eyes grow dim from suffering;
they grow weak because of all my enemies.
Psalm 6:8:
turn back from me, all you who behave wickedly,
for the lord has heard the sound of my weeping.
Psalm 6:9:
the lord has heard my appeal for mercy;
the lord has accepted my prayer.
Psalm 6:10:
they will be humiliated and absolutely terrified.
all my enemies will turn back and be suddenly humiliated.
Psalm 7:1:
o lord my god, in you i have taken shelter.
deliver me from all who chase me. rescue me!
Psalm 7:2:
otherwise they will rip me to shreds like a lion;
they will tear me to bits and no one will be able to rescue me.
Psalm 7:3:
o lord my god, if i have done what they say,
or am guilty of unjust actions,
Psalm 7:4:
or have wronged my ally,
or helped his lawless enemy,
Psalm 7:6:
stand up angrily, lord.
rise up with raging fury against my enemies.
wake up for my sake, and execute the judgment you have decreed for them.
Psalm 7:7:
the countries are assembled all around you;
take once more your rightful place over them.
Psalm 7:8:
the lord judges the nations.
vindicate me, lord, because i am innocent,
because i am blameless, o exalted one.
Psalm 7:9:
may the evil deeds of the wicked come to an end.
but make the innocent secure,
o righteous god,
you who examine inner thoughts and motives.
Psalm 7:10:
the exalted god is my shield,
the one who delivers the morally upright.
Psalm 7:11:
god is a just judge;
he is angry throughout the day.
Psalm 7:12:
if a person does not repent, god will wield his sword.
he has prepared to shoot his bow.
Psalm 7:13:
he has prepared deadly weapons to use against him;
he gets ready to shoot flaming arrows.
Psalm 7:14:
see the one who is pregnant with wickedness,
who conceives destructive plans,
and gives birth to harmful lies—
Psalm 7:15:
he digs a pit
and then falls into the hole he has made.
Psalm 7:16:
he becomes the victim of his own destructive plans—
and the violence he intended for others falls on his own head.
Psalm 7:17:
i will thank the lord for his justice;
i will sing praises to the lord most high!
Psalm 8:1:
o lord, our lord,
how magnificent is your reputation throughout the earth!
you reveal your majesty in the heavens above.
Psalm 8:2:
from the mouths of children and nursing babies
you have ordained praise on account of your adversaries,
so that you might put an end to the vindictive enemy.
Psalm 8:3:
when i look up at the heavens, which your fingers made,
and see the moon and the stars, which you set in place,
Psalm 8:4:
of what importance is the human race, that you should notice them?
of what importance is mankind, that you should pay attention to them?
Psalm 8:5:
you made them a little less than the heavenly beings.
you crowned mankind with honor and majesty.
Psalm 8:6:
you appoint them to rule over your creation;
you have placed everything under their authority,
Psalm 8:7:
including all the sheep and cattle,
as well as the wild animals,
Psalm 8:8:
the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea,
and everything that moves through the currents of the seas.
Psalm 8:9:
o lord, our lord,
how magnificent is your reputation throughout the earth!
Psalm 9:1:
i will thank the lord with all my heart!
i will tell about all your amazing deeds.
Psalm 9:2:
i will be happy and rejoice in you.
i will sing praises to you, o most high.
Psalm 9:3:
when my enemies turn back,
they trip and are defeated before you.
Psalm 9:4:
for you defended my just cause;
from your throne you pronounced a just decision.
Psalm 9:7:
but the lord rules forever;
he reigns in a just manner.
Psalm 9:8:
he judges the world fairly;
he makes just legal decisions for the nations.
Psalm 9:9:
consequently the lord provides safety for the oppressed;
he provides safety in times of trouble.
Psalm 9:10:
your loyal followers trust in you,
for you, lord, do not abandon those who seek your help.
Psalm 9:11:
sing praises to the lord, who rules in zion.
tell the nations what he has done.
Psalm 9:12:
for the one who takes revenge against murderers took notice of the oppressed;
he did not overlook their cry for help
Psalm 9:13:
when they prayed:
“have mercy on me, lord!
see how i am oppressed by those who hate me,
o one who can snatch me away from the gates of death!
Psalm 9:14:
then i will tell about all your praiseworthy acts;
in the gates of daughter zion i will rejoice because of your deliverance.”
Psalm 9:15:
the nations fell into the pit they had made;
their feet were caught in the net they had hidden.
Psalm 9:17:
the wicked are turned back and sent to sheol;
this is the destiny of all the nations that ignore god,
Psalm 9:18:
for the needy are not permanently ignored,
the hopes of the oppressed are not forever dashed.
Psalm 9:19:
rise up, lord!
don’t let men be defiant.
may the nations be judged in your presence.
Psalm 9:20:
terrify them, lord.
let the nations know they are mere mortals. (selah)
Psalm 10:1:
why, lord, do you stand far off?
why do you pay no attention during times of trouble?
Psalm 10:2:
the wicked arrogantly chase the oppressed;
the oppressed are trapped by the schemes the wicked have dreamed up.
Psalm 10:3:
yes, the wicked man boasts because he gets what he wants;
the one who robs others curses and rejects the lord.
Psalm 10:4:
the wicked man is so arrogant he always thinks,
“god won’t hold me accountable; he doesn’t care.”
Psalm 10:6:
he says to himself,
“i will never be shaken,
because i experience no calamity.”
Psalm 10:7:
his mouth is full of curses and deceptive, harmful words;
his tongue injures and destroys.
Psalm 10:10:
his victims are crushed and beaten down;
they are trapped in his sturdy nets.
Psalm 10:12:
rise up, lord!
o god, strike him down.
do not forget the oppressed.
Psalm 10:13:
why does the wicked man reject god?
he says to himself, “you will not hold me accountable.”
Psalm 10:14:
you have taken notice,
for you always see one who inflicts pain and suffering.
the unfortunate victim entrusts his cause to you;
you deliver the fatherless.
Psalm 10:15:
break the arm of the wicked and evil man.
hold him accountable for his wicked deeds,
which he thought you would not discover.
Psalm 10:16:
the lord rules forever!
the nations are driven out of his land.
Psalm 10:17:
lord, you have heard the request of the oppressed;
you make them feel secure because you listen to their prayer.
Psalm 10:18:
you defend the fatherless and oppressed,
so that mere mortals may no longer terrorize them.
Psalm 11:1:
in the lord i have taken shelter.
how can you say to me,
“flee to a mountain like a bird.
Psalm 11:3:
when the foundations are destroyed,
what can the godly accomplish?”
Psalm 11:5:
the lord approves of the godly,
but he hates the wicked and those who love to do violence.
Psalm 11:6:
may he rain down burning coals and brimstone on the wicked!
a whirlwind is what they deserve.
Psalm 12:2:
people lie to one another;
they flatter and deceive.
Psalm 12:3:
may the lord cut off all flattering lips,
and the tongue that boasts!
Psalm 12:5:
“because of the violence done to the oppressed,
because of the painful cries of the needy,
i will spring into action,” says the lord.
“i will provide the safety they so desperately desire.”
Psalm 12:6:
the lord’s words are absolutely reliable.
they are as untainted as silver purified in a furnace on the ground,
where it is thoroughly refined.
Psalm 12:7:
you, lord, will protect them;
you will continually shelter each one from these evil people,
Psalm 12:8:
for the wicked seem to be everywhere,
when people promote evil.
Psalm 13:1:
how long, lord, will you continue to ignore me?
how long will you pay no attention to me?
Psalm 13:2:
how long must i worry,
and suffer in broad daylight?
how long will my enemy gloat over me?
Psalm 13:3:
look at me! answer me, o lord my god!
revive me, or else i will die.
Psalm 13:4:
then my enemy will say, “i have defeated him.”
then my foes will rejoice because i am shaken.
Psalm 13:5:
but i trust in your faithfulness.
may i rejoice because of your deliverance.
Psalm 13:6:
i will sing praises to the lord
when he vindicates me.
Psalm 14:2:
the lord looks down from heaven at the human race,
to see if there is anyone who is wise and seeks god.
Psalm 14:3:
everyone rejects god;
they are all morally corrupt.
none of them does what is right,
not even one.
Psalm 14:4:
all those who behave wickedly do not understand—
those who devour my people as if they were eating bread,
and do not call out to the lord.
Psalm 14:5:
they are absolutely terrified,
for god defends the godly.
Psalm 14:6:
you want to humiliate the oppressed,
even though the lord is their shelter.
Psalm 14:7:
i wish the deliverance of israel would come from zion!
when the lord restores the well-being of his people,
may jacob rejoice,
may israel be happy!
Psalm 15:1:
lord, who may be a guest in your home?
who may live on your holy hill?
Psalm 15:2:
whoever lives a blameless life,
does what is right,
and speaks honestly.
Psalm 15:3:
he does not slander,
or do harm to others,
or insult his neighbor.
Psalm 15:4:
he despises a reprobate,
but honors the lord’s loyal followers.
he makes firm commitments and does not renege on his promise.
Psalm 15:5:
he does not charge interest when he lends his money.
he does not take bribes to testify against the innocent.
the one who lives like this will never be shaken.
Psalm 16:1: protect me, o god, for i have taken shelter in you.
Psalm 16:2:
i say to the lord, “you are the lord,
my only source of well-being.”
Psalm 16:3:
as for god’s chosen people who are in the land,
and the leading officials i admired so much—
Psalm 16:4:
their troubles multiply;
they desire other gods.
i will not pour out drink offerings of blood to their gods,
nor will i make vows in the name of their gods.
Psalm 16:5:
lord, you give me stability and prosperity;
you make my future secure.
Psalm 16:6:
it is as if i have been given fertile fields
or received a beautiful tract of land.
Psalm 16:7:
i will praise the lord who guides me;
yes, during the night i reflect and learn.
Psalm 16:8:
i constantly trust in the lord;
because he is at my right hand, i will not be shaken.
Psalm 16:10:
you will not abandon me to sheol;
you will not allow your faithful follower to see the pit.
Psalm 17:1:
lord, consider my just cause.
pay attention to my cry for help.
listen to the prayer
i sincerely offer.
Psalm 17:2:
make a just decision on my behalf.
decide what is right.
Psalm 17:3:
you have scrutinized my inner motives;
you have examined me during the night.
you have carefully evaluated me, but you find no sin.
i am determined i will say nothing sinful.
Psalm 17:4:
as for the actions of people—
just as you have commanded,
i have not followed in the footsteps of violent men.
Psalm 17:5:
i carefully obey your commands;
i do not deviate from them.
Psalm 17:6:
i call to you because you will answer me, o god.
listen to me!
hear what i say!
Psalm 17:7:
accomplish awesome, faithful deeds,
you who powerfully deliver those who look to you for protection from their enemies.
Psalm 17:8:
protect me as you would protect the pupil of your eye.
hide me in the shadow of your wings.
Psalm 17:9:
protect me from the wicked men who attack me,
my enemies who crowd around me for the kill.
Psalm 17:10:
they are calloused;
they speak arrogantly.
Psalm 17:11:
they attack me, now they surround me;
they intend to throw me to the ground.
Psalm 17:12:
he is like a lion that wants to tear its prey to bits,
like a young lion crouching in hidden places.
Psalm 17:13:
rise up, lord!
confront him. knock him down.
use your sword to rescue me from the wicked man.
Psalm 17:14:
lord, use your power to deliver me from these murderers,
from the murderers of this world.
they enjoy prosperity;
you overwhelm them with the riches they desire.
they have many children,
and leave their wealth to their offspring.
Psalm 17:15:
as for me, because i am innocent i will see your face;
when i awake you will reveal yourself to me.
Psalm 18:1:
he said:
“i love you, lord, my source of strength!
Psalm 18:2:
the lord is my high ridge, my stronghold, my deliverer.
my god is my rocky summit where i take shelter,
my shield, the horn that saves me, and my refuge.
Psalm 18:3:
i called to the lord, who is worthy of praise,
and i was delivered from my enemies.
Psalm 18:4:
the waves of death engulfed me,
the currents of chaos overwhelmed me.
Psalm 18:5:
the ropes of sheol tightened around me,
the snares of death trapped me.
Psalm 18:9:
he made the sky sink as he descended;
a thick cloud was under his feet.
Psalm 18:10:
he mounted a winged angel and flew;
he glided on the wings of the wind.
Psalm 18:11:
he shrouded himself in darkness,
in thick rain clouds.
Psalm 18:12:
from the brightness in front of him came
hail and fiery coals.
Psalm 18:13:
the lord thundered in the sky;
the most high shouted.
Psalm 18:14:
he shot his arrows and scattered them,
many lightning bolts and routed them.
Psalm 18:15:
the depths of the sea were exposed;
the inner regions of the world were uncovered
by your battle cry, lord,
by the powerful breath from your nose.
Psalm 18:16:
he reached down from above and took hold of me;
he pulled me from the surging water.
Psalm 18:18:
they confronted me in my day of calamity,
but the lord helped me.
Psalm 18:19:
he brought me out into a wide open place;
he delivered me because he was pleased with me.
Psalm 18:20:
the lord repaid me for my godly deeds;
he rewarded my blameless behavior.
Psalm 18:21:
for i have obeyed the lord’s commands;
i have not rebelled against my god.
Psalm 18:22:
for i am aware of all his regulations,
and i do not reject his rules.
Psalm 18:23:
i was innocent before him,
and kept myself from sinning.
Psalm 18:24:
the lord rewarded me for my godly deeds;
he took notice of my blameless behavior.
Psalm 18:25:
you prove to be loyal to one who is faithful;
you prove to be trustworthy to one who is innocent.
Psalm 18:26:
you prove to be reliable to one who is blameless,
but you prove to be deceptive to one who is perverse.
Psalm 18:27:
for you deliver oppressed people,
but you bring down those who have a proud look.
Psalm 18:28:
indeed, you light my lamp, lord.
my god illuminates the darkness around me.
Psalm 18:29:
indeed, with your help i can charge against an army;
by my god’s power i can jump over a wall.
Psalm 18:31:
indeed, who is god besides the lord?
who is a protector besides our god?
Psalm 18:32:
the one true god gives me strength;
he removes the obstacles in my way.
Psalm 18:33:
he gives me the agility of a deer;
he enables me to negotiate the rugged terrain.
Psalm 18:34:
he trains my hands for battle;
my arms can bend even the strongest bow.
Psalm 18:36:
you widen my path;
my feet do not slip.
Psalm 18:37:
i chase my enemies and catch them;
i do not turn back until i wipe them out.
Psalm 18:38:
i beat them to death;
they fall at my feet.
Psalm 18:39:
you give me strength for battle;
you make my foes kneel before me.
Psalm 18:40:
you make my enemies retreat;
i destroy those who hate me.
Psalm 18:41:
they cry out, but there is no one to help them;
they cry out to the lord, but he does not answer them.
Psalm 18:42:
i grind them as fine windblown dust;
i beat them underfoot like clay in the streets.
Psalm 18:44:
when they hear of my exploits, they submit to me.
foreigners are powerless before me.
Psalm 18:45:
foreigners lose their courage;
they shake with fear as they leave their strongholds.
Psalm 18:46:
the lord is alive!
my protector is praiseworthy.
the god who delivers me is exalted as king.
Psalm 18:47:
the one true god completely vindicates me;
he makes nations submit to me.
Psalm 18:49:
so i will give you thanks before the nations, o lord.
i will sing praises to you.
Psalm 19:1:
the heavens declare the glory of god;
the sky displays his handiwork.
Psalm 19:2:
day after day it speaks out;
night after night it reveals his greatness.
Psalm 19:3:
there is no actual speech or word,
nor is its voice literally heard.
Psalm 19:5:
like a bridegroom it emerges from its chamber;
like a strong man it enjoys running its course.
Psalm 19:7:
the law of the lord is perfect
and preserves one’s life.
the rules set down by the lord are reliable
and impart wisdom to the inexperienced.
Psalm 19:8:
the lord’s precepts are fair
and make one joyful.
the lord’s commands are pure
and give insight for life.
Psalm 19:9:
the commands to fear the lord are right
and endure forever.
the judgments given by the lord are trustworthy
and absolutely just.
Psalm 19:10:
they are of greater value than gold,
than even a great amount of pure gold;
they bring greater delight than honey,
than even the sweetest honey from a honeycomb.
Psalm 19:11:
yes, your servant finds moral guidance there;
those who obey them receive a rich reward.
Psalm 19:12:
who can know all his errors?
please do not punish me for sins i am unaware of.
Psalm 19:13:
moreover, keep me from committing flagrant sins;
do not allow such sins to control me.
then i will be blameless,
and innocent of blatant rebellion.
Psalm 19:14:
may my words and my thoughts
be acceptable in your sight,
o lord, my sheltering rock and my redeemer.
Psalm 20:1:
may the lord answer you when you are in trouble;
may the god of jacob make you secure.
Psalm 20:2:
may he send you help from his temple;
from zion may he give you support.
Psalm 20:3:
may he take notice of all your offerings;
may he accept your burnt sacrifice. (selah)
Psalm 20:4:
may he grant your heart’s desire;
may he bring all your plans to pass.
Psalm 20:7:
some trust in chariots and others in horses,
but we depend on the lord our god.
Psalm 20:8:
they will fall down,
but we will stand firm.
Psalm 20:9:
the lord will deliver the king;
he will answer us when we call to him for help!
Psalm 21:1:
o lord, the king rejoices in the strength you give;
he takes great delight in the deliverance you provide.
Psalm 21:2:
you grant him his heart’s desire;
you do not refuse his request. (selah)
Psalm 21:3:
for you bring him rich blessings;
you place a golden crown on his head.
Psalm 21:4:
he asked you to sustain his life,
and you have granted him long life and an enduring dynasty.
Psalm 21:5:
your deliverance brings him great honor;
you give him majestic splendor.
Psalm 21:6:
for you grant him lasting blessings;
you give him great joy by allowing him into your presence.
Psalm 21:7:
for the king trusts in the lord,
and because of the most high’s faithfulness he is not shaken.
Psalm 21:8:
you prevail over all your enemies;
your power is too great for those who hate you.
Psalm 21:10:
you destroy their offspring from the earth,
their descendants from among the human race.
Psalm 21:11:
yes, they intend to do you harm;
they dream up a scheme, but they do not succeed.
Psalm 21:12:
for you make them retreat
when you aim your arrows at them.
Psalm 21:13:
rise up, o lord, in strength!
we will sing and praise your power.
Psalm 22:1:
my god, my god, why have you abandoned me?
i groan in prayer, but help seems far away.
Psalm 22:2:
my god, i cry out during the day,
but you do not answer,
and during the night my prayers do not let up.
Psalm 22:3:
you are holy;
you sit as king receiving the praises of israel.
Psalm 22:4:
in you our ancestors trusted;
they trusted in you and you rescued them.
Psalm 22:5:
to you they cried out, and they were saved;
in you they trusted and they were not disappointed.
Psalm 22:6:
but i am a worm, not a man;
people insult me and despise me.
Psalm 22:7:
all who see me taunt me;
they mock me and shake their heads.
Psalm 22:8:
they say,
“commit yourself to the lord!
let the lord rescue him!
let the lord deliver him, for he delights in him.”
Psalm 22:9:
yes, you are the one who brought me out from the womb
and made me feel secure on my mother’s breasts.
Psalm 22:10:
i have been dependent on you since birth;
from the time i came out of my mother’s womb you have been my god.
Psalm 22:11:
do not remain far away from me,
for trouble is near and i have no one to help me.
Psalm 22:12:
many bulls surround me;
powerful bulls of bashan hem me in.
Psalm 22:13:
they open their mouths to devour me
like a roaring lion that rips its prey.
Psalm 22:17:
i can count all my bones;
my enemies are gloating over me in triumph.
Psalm 22:18:
they are dividing up my clothes among themselves;
they are rolling dice for my garments.
Psalm 22:19:
but you, o lord, do not remain far away.
you are my source of strength. hurry and help me!
Psalm 22:20:
deliver me from the sword.
save my life from the claws of the wild dogs.
Psalm 22:21:
rescue me from the mouth of the lion,
and from the horns of the wild oxen.
you have answered me.
Psalm 22:22:
i will declare your name to my countrymen.
in the middle of the assembly i will praise you.
Psalm 22:23:
you loyal followers of the lord, praise him.
all you descendants of jacob, honor him.
all you descendants of israel, stand in awe of him.
Psalm 22:25:
you are the reason i offer praise in the great assembly;
i will fulfill my promises before the lord’s loyal followers.
Psalm 22:26:
let the oppressed eat and be filled.
let those who seek his help praise the lord.
may you live forever!
Psalm 22:27:
let all the people of the earth acknowledge the lord and turn to him.
let all the nations worship you.
Psalm 22:28:
for the lord is king
and rules over the nations.
Psalm 22:30:
a whole generation will serve him;
they will tell the next generation about the lord.
Psalm 22:31:
they will come and tell about his saving deeds;
they will tell a future generation what he has accomplished.
Psalm 23:1:
the lord is my shepherd,
i lack nothing.
Psalm 23:2:
he takes me to lush pastures,
he leads me to refreshing water.
Psalm 23:3:
he restores my strength.
he leads me down the right paths
for the sake of his reputation.
Psalm 23:4:
even when i must walk through the darkest valley,
i fear no danger,
for you are with me;
your rod and your staff reassure me.
Psalm 23:5:
you prepare a feast before me
in plain sight of my enemies.
you refresh my head with oil;
my cup is completely full.
Psalm 23:6:
surely your goodness and faithfulness will pursue me all my days,
and i will live in the lord’s house for the rest of my life.
Psalm 24:1:
the lord owns the earth and all it contains,
the world and all who live in it.
Psalm 24:2:
for he set its foundation upon the seas,
and established it upon the ocean currents.
Psalm 24:3:
who is allowed to ascend the mountain of the lord?
who may go up to his holy dwelling place?
Psalm 24:4:
the one whose deeds are blameless
and whose motives are pure,
who does not lie,
or make promises with no intention of keeping them.
Psalm 24:5:
such godly people are rewarded by the lord,
and vindicated by the god who delivers them.
Psalm 24:6:
such purity characterizes the people who seek his favor,
jacob’s descendants, who pray to him. (selah)
Psalm 24:7:
look up, you gates.
rise up, you eternal doors.
then the majestic king will enter.
Psalm 24:8:
who is this majestic king?
the lord who is strong and mighty.
the lord who is mighty in battle.
Psalm 24:9:
look up, you gates.
rise up, you eternal doors.
then the majestic king will enter.
Psalm 24:10:
who is this majestic king?
the lord of heaven’s armies.
he is the majestic king. (selah)
Psalm 25:1: o lord, i come before you in prayer.
Psalm 25:3:
certainly none who rely on you will be humiliated.
those who deal in treachery will be thwarted and humiliated.
Psalm 25:4:
make me understand your ways, o lord.
teach me your paths.
Psalm 25:6:
remember your compassionate and faithful deeds, o lord,
for you have always acted in this manner.
Psalm 25:7:
do not hold against me the sins of my youth or my rebellious acts.
because you are faithful to me, extend to me your favor, o lord.
Psalm 25:8:
the lord is both kind and fair;
that is why he teaches sinners the right way to live.
Psalm 25:9:
may he show the humble what is right.
may he teach the humble his way.
Psalm 25:10:
the lord always proves faithful and reliable
to those who follow the demands of his covenant.
Psalm 25:11:
for the sake of your reputation, o lord,
forgive my sin, because it is great.
Psalm 25:12:
the lord shows his faithful followers
the way they should live.
Psalm 25:13:
they experience his favor;
their descendants inherit the land.
Psalm 25:14:
the lord’s loyal followers receive his guidance,
and he reveals his covenantal demands to them.
Psalm 25:15:
i continually look to the lord for help,
for he will free my feet from the enemy’s net.
Psalm 25:16:
turn toward me and have mercy on me,
for i am alone and oppressed.
Psalm 25:17:
deliver me from my distress;
rescue me from my suffering.
Psalm 25:18:
see my pain and suffering.
forgive all my sins.
Psalm 25:19:
watch my enemies, for they outnumber me;
they hate me and want to harm me.
Psalm 25:20:
protect me and deliver me!
please do not let me be humiliated,
for i have taken shelter in you.
Psalm 25:21:
may integrity and godliness protect me,
for i rely on you.
Psalm 25:22:
o god, rescue israel
from all their distress!
Psalm 26:2:
examine me, o lord, and test me.
evaluate my inner thoughts and motives.
Psalm 26:3:
for i am ever aware of your faithfulness,
and your loyalty continually motivates me.
Psalm 26:4:
i do not associate with deceitful men,
or consort with those who are dishonest.
Psalm 26:5:
i hate the mob of evil men,
and do not associate with the wicked.
Psalm 26:6:
i maintain a pure lifestyle,
so i can appear before your altar, o lord,
Psalm 26:7:
to give you thanks,
and to tell about all your amazing deeds.
Psalm 26:8:
o lord, i love the temple where you live,
the place where your splendor is revealed.
Psalm 26:9:
do not sweep me away with sinners,
or execute me along with violent people,
Psalm 26:10:
who are always ready to do wrong
or offer a bribe.
Psalm 26:11:
but i have integrity.
rescue me and have mercy on me!
Psalm 26:12:
i am safe,
and among the worshipers i will praise the lord.
Psalm 27:1:
the lord is my light and my salvation.
i fear no one.
the lord protects my life.
i am afraid of no one.
Psalm 27:2:
when evil men attack me
to devour my flesh,
when my adversaries and enemies attack me,
they stumble and fall.
Psalm 27:3:
even when an army is deployed against me,
i do not fear.
even when war is imminent,
i remain confident.
Psalm 27:4:
i have asked the lord for one thing—
this is what i desire!
i want to live in the lord’s house all the days of my life,
so i can gaze at the splendor of the lord
and contemplate in his temple.
Psalm 27:6:
now i will triumph
over my enemies who surround me.
i will offer sacrifices in his dwelling place and shout for joy.
i will sing praises to the lord.
Psalm 27:7:
hear me, o lord, when i cry out.
have mercy on me and answer me.
Psalm 27:8:
my heart tells me to pray to you,
and i do pray to you, o lord.
Psalm 27:9:
do not reject me.
do not push your servant away in anger.
you are my deliverer.
do not forsake or abandon me,
o god who vindicates me.
Psalm 27:10:
even if my father and mother abandoned me,
the lord would take me in.
Psalm 27:11:
teach me how you want me to live, lord;
lead me along a level path because of those who wait to ambush me.
Psalm 27:12:
do not turn me over to my enemies,
for false witnesses who want to destroy me testify against me.
Psalm 27:13:
where would i be if i did not believe i would experience
the lord’s favor in the land of the living?
Psalm 27:14:
rely on the lord!
be strong and confident!
rely on the lord!
Psalm 28:1:
to you, o lord, i cry out!
my protector, do not ignore me.
if you do not respond to me,
i will join those who are descending into the grave.
Psalm 28:2:
hear my plea for mercy when i cry out to you for help,
when i lift my hands toward your holy temple.
Psalm 28:3:
do not drag me away with evil men,
with those who behave wickedly,
who talk so friendly to their neighbors,
while they plan to harm them.
Psalm 28:4:
pay them back for their evil deeds.
pay them back for what they do.
punish them.
Psalm 28:6:
the lord deserves praise,
for he has heard my plea for mercy.
Psalm 28:8:
the lord strengthens his people;
he protects and delivers his chosen king.
Psalm 28:9:
deliver your people.
empower the nation that belongs to you.
care for them like a shepherd and carry them in your arms at all times!
Psalm 29:1:
acknowledge the lord, you heavenly beings,
acknowledge the lord’s majesty and power.
Psalm 29:2:
acknowledge the majesty of the lord’s reputation.
worship the lord in holy attire.
Psalm 29:4:
the lord’s shout is powerful,
the lord’s shout is majestic.
Psalm 29:5:
the lord’s shout breaks the cedars,
the lord shatters the cedars of lebanon.
Psalm 29:6:
he makes them skip like a calf,
lebanon and sirion like a young ox.
Psalm 29:7: the lord’s shout strikes with flaming fire.
Psalm 29:8:
the lord’s shout shakes the wilderness,
the lord shakes the wilderness of kadesh.
Psalm 29:9:
the lord’s shout bends the large trees
and strips the leaves from the forests.
everyone in his temple says, “majestic!”
Psalm 29:10:
the lord sits enthroned over the engulfing waters,
the lord sits enthroned as the eternal king.
Psalm 29:11:
the lord gives his people strength;
the lord grants his people security.
Psalm 30:1:
i will praise you, o lord, for you lifted me up,
and did not allow my enemies to gloat over me.
Psalm 30:2:
o lord my god,
i cried out to you and you healed me.
Psalm 30:3:
o lord, you pulled me up from sheol;
you rescued me from among those descending into the grave.
Psalm 30:4:
sing to the lord, you faithful followers of his;
give thanks to his holy name.
Psalm 30:5:
for his anger lasts only a brief moment,
and his good favor restores one’s life.
one may experience sorrow during the night,
but joy arrives in the morning.
Psalm 30:6:
in my self-confidence i said,
“i will never be shaken.”
Psalm 30:7:
o lord, in your good favor you made me secure.
then you rejected me and i was terrified.
Psalm 30:8:
to you, o lord, i cried out;
i begged the lord for mercy:
Psalm 30:9:
“what profit is there in taking my life,
in my descending into the pit?
can the dust of the grave praise you?
can it declare your loyalty?
Psalm 30:10:
hear, o lord, and have mercy on me.
o lord, deliver me.”
Psalm 30:11:
then you turned my lament into dancing;
you removed my sackcloth and covered me with joy.
Psalm 30:12:
so now my heart will sing to you and not be silent;
o lord my god, i will always give thanks to you.
Psalm 31:1:
in you, o lord, i have taken shelter.
never let me be humiliated.
vindicate me by rescuing me.
Psalm 31:2:
listen to me.
quickly deliver me.
be my protector and refuge,
a stronghold where i can be safe.
Psalm 31:3:
for you are my high ridge and my stronghold;
for the sake of your own reputation you lead me and guide me.
Psalm 31:4:
you will free me from the net they hid for me,
for you are my place of refuge.
Psalm 31:5:
into your hand i entrust my life;
you will rescue me, o lord, the faithful god.
Psalm 31:6:
i hate those who serve worthless idols,
but i trust in the lord.
Psalm 31:7:
i will be happy and rejoice in your faithfulness,
because you notice my pain
and you are aware of how distressed i am.
Psalm 31:8:
you do not deliver me over to the power of the enemy;
you enable me to stand in a wide open place.
Psalm 31:9:
have mercy on me, lord, for i am in distress!
my eyes grow dim from suffering.
i have lost my strength.
Psalm 31:10:
for my life nears its end in pain;
my years draw to a close as i groan.
my strength fails me because of my sin,
and my bones become brittle.
Psalm 31:12:
i am forgotten, like a dead man no one thinks about;
i am regarded as worthless, like a broken jar.
Psalm 31:13:
for i hear what so many are saying,
the terrifying news that comes from every direction.
when they plot together against me,
they figure out how they can take my life.
Psalm 31:14:
but i trust in you, o lord!
i declare, “you are my god!”
Psalm 31:15:
you determine my destiny.
rescue me from the power of my enemies and those who chase me.
Psalm 31:16:
smile on your servant.
deliver me because of your faithfulness.
Psalm 31:17:
o lord, do not let me be humiliated,
for i call out to you.
may evil men be humiliated.
may they go wailing to the grave.
Psalm 31:18:
may lying lips be silenced—
lips that speak defiantly against the innocent
with arrogance and contempt.
Psalm 31:19:
how great is your favor,
which you store up for your loyal followers.
in plain sight of everyone you bestow it on those who take shelter in you.
Psalm 31:20:
you hide them with you, where they are safe from the attacks of men;
you conceal them in a shelter, where they are safe from slanderous attacks.
Psalm 31:21:
the lord deserves praise
for he demonstrated his amazing faithfulness to me when i was besieged by enemies.
Psalm 31:22:
i jumped to conclusions and said,
“i am cut off from your presence!”
but you heard my plea for mercy when i cried out to you for help.
Psalm 31:23:
love the lord, all you faithful followers of his!
the lord protects those who have integrity,
but he pays back in full the one who acts arrogantly.
Psalm 31:24:
be strong and confident,
all you who wait on the lord.
Psalm 32:1:
how blessed is the one whose rebellious acts are forgiven,
whose sin is pardoned.
Psalm 32:2:
how blessed is the one whose wrongdoing the lord does not punish,
in whose spirit there is no deceit.
Psalm 32:3:
when i refused to confess my sin,
my whole body wasted away,
while i groaned in pain all day long.
Psalm 32:4:
for day and night you tormented me;
you tried to destroy me in the intense heat of summer. (selah)
Psalm 32:5:
then i confessed my sin;
i no longer covered up my wrongdoing.
i said, “i will confess my rebellious acts to the lord.”
and then you forgave my sins. (selah)
Psalm 32:6:
for this reason every one of your faithful followers should pray to you
while there is a window of opportunity.
certainly when the surging water rises,
it will not reach them.
Psalm 32:8:
i will instruct and teach you about how you should live.
i will advise you as i look you in the eye.
Psalm 32:9:
do not be like an unintelligent horse or mule,
which will not obey you
unless they are controlled by a bridle and bit.
Psalm 32:10:
an evil person suffers much pain,
but the lord’s faithfulness overwhelms the one who trusts in him.
Psalm 32:11:
rejoice in the lord and be happy, you who are godly!
shout for joy, all you who are morally upright!
Psalm 33:1:
you godly ones, shout for joy because of the lord!
it is appropriate for the morally upright to offer him praise.
Psalm 33:2:
give thanks to the lord with the harp.
sing to him to the accompaniment of a ten-stringed instrument.
Psalm 33:3:
sing to him a new song.
play skillfully as you shout out your praises to him.
Psalm 33:4:
for the lord’s decrees are just,
and everything he does is fair.
Psalm 33:5:
he promotes equity and justice;
the lord’s faithfulness extends throughout the earth.
Psalm 33:6:
by the lord’s decree the heavens were made,
and by the breath of his mouth all the starry hosts.
Psalm 33:7:
he piles up the water of the sea;
he puts the oceans in storehouses.
Psalm 33:8:
let the whole earth fear the lord.
let all who live in the world stand in awe of him.
Psalm 33:9:
for he spoke, and it came into existence.
he issued the decree, and it stood firm.
Psalm 33:10:
the lord frustrates the decisions of the nations;
he nullifies the plans of the peoples.
Psalm 33:11:
the lord’s decisions stand forever;
his plans abide throughout the ages.
Psalm 33:12:
how blessed is the nation whose god is the lord,
the people whom he has chosen to be his special possession.
Psalm 33:13:
the lord watches from heaven;
he sees all people.
Psalm 33:14:
from the place where he lives he looks carefully
at all the earth’s inhabitants.
Psalm 33:15:
he is the one who forms every human heart,
and takes note of all their actions.
Psalm 33:16:
no king is delivered by his vast army;
a warrior is not saved by his great might.
Psalm 33:17:
a horse disappoints those who trust in it for victory;
despite its great strength, it cannot deliver.
Psalm 33:18:
look, the lord takes notice of his loyal followers,
those who wait for him to demonstrate his faithfulness
Psalm 33:19:
by saving their lives from death
and sustaining them during times of famine.
Psalm 33:20:
we wait for the lord;
he is our deliverer and shield.
Psalm 33:21:
for our hearts rejoice in him,
for we trust in his holy name.
Psalm 33:22:
may we experience your faithfulness, o lord,
for we wait for you.
Psalm 34:1:
i will praise the lord at all times;
my mouth will continually praise him.
Psalm 34:2:
i will boast in the lord;
let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
Psalm 34:3:
magnify the lord with me.
let us praise his name together.
Psalm 34:4:
i sought the lord’s help and he answered me;
he delivered me from all my fears.
Psalm 34:5:
look to him and be radiant;
do not let your faces be ashamed.
Psalm 34:6:
this oppressed man cried out and the lord heard;
he saved him from all his troubles.
Psalm 34:7:
the angel of the lord camps around
the lord’s loyal followers and delivers them.
Psalm 34:8:
taste and see that the lord is good.
how blessed is the one who takes shelter in him.
Psalm 34:9:
fear the lord, you chosen people of his,
for those who fear him lack nothing.
Psalm 34:10:
even young lions sometimes lack food and are hungry,
but those who seek the lord lack no good thing.
Psalm 34:11:
come children. listen to me.
i will teach you what it means to fear the lord.
Psalm 34:12:
do you want to really live?
would you love to live a long, happy life?
Psalm 34:13:
then make sure you don’t speak evil words
or use deceptive speech.
Psalm 34:14:
turn away from evil and do what is right.
strive for peace and promote it.
Psalm 34:15:
the lord pays attention to the godly
and hears their cry for help.
Psalm 34:16:
but the lord opposes evildoers
and wipes out all memory of them from the earth.
Psalm 34:17:
the godly cry out and the lord hears;
he saves them from all their troubles.
Psalm 34:18:
the lord is near the brokenhearted;
he delivers those who are discouraged.
Psalm 34:19:
the godly face many dangers,
but the lord saves them from each one of them.
Psalm 34:20:
he protects all his bones;
not one of them is broken.
Psalm 34:21:
evil people self-destruct;
those who hate the godly are punished.
Psalm 34:22:
the lord rescues his servants;
all who take shelter in him escape punishment.
Psalm 35:1:
o lord, fight those who fight with me.
attack those who attack me.
Psalm 35:2:
grab your small shield and large shield,
and rise up to help me.
Psalm 35:3:
use your spear and lance against those who chase me.
assure me with these words: “i am your deliverer.”
Psalm 35:4:
may those who seek my life be embarrassed and humiliated.
may those who plan to harm me be turned back and ashamed.
Psalm 35:5:
may they be like wind-driven chaff,
as the angel of the lord attacks them.
Psalm 35:6:
may their path be dark and slippery,
as the angel of the lord chases them.
Psalm 35:7:
i did not harm them, but they hid a net to catch me
and dug a pit to trap me.
Psalm 35:8:
let destruction take them by surprise.
let the net they hid catch them.
let them fall into destruction.
Psalm 35:9:
then i will rejoice in the lord
and be happy because of his deliverance.
Psalm 35:10:
with all my strength i will say,
“o lord, who can compare to you?
you rescue the oppressed from those who try to overpower them,
the oppressed and needy from those who try to rob them.”
Psalm 35:11:
violent men perjure themselves,
and falsely accuse me.
Psalm 35:12:
they repay me evil for the good i have done;
i am overwhelmed with sorrow.
Psalm 35:13:
when they were sick, i wore sackcloth,
and refrained from eating food.
(if i am lying, may my prayers go unanswered.)
Psalm 35:14:
i mourned for them as i would for a friend or my brother.
i bowed down in sorrow as if i were mourning for my mother.
Psalm 35:16:
when i tripped, they taunted me relentlessly,
and tried to bite me.
Psalm 35:18:
then i will give you thanks in the great assembly;
i will praise you before a large crowd of people.
Psalm 35:19:
do not let those who are my enemies for no reason gloat over me.
do not let those who hate me without cause carry out their wicked schemes.
Psalm 35:20:
for they do not try to make peace with others,
but plan ways to deceive those who live peacefully in the land.
Psalm 35:21:
they are ready to devour me;
they say, “aha! aha! we’ve got you!”
Psalm 35:22:
but you take notice, lord; do not be silent!
o lord, do not remain far away from me.
Psalm 35:23:
rouse yourself, wake up and vindicate me.
my god and lord, defend my just cause.
Psalm 35:24:
vindicate me by your justice, o lord my god.
do not let them gloat over me.
Psalm 35:25:
do not let them say to themselves, “aha! we have what we wanted!”
do not let them say, “we have devoured him.”
Psalm 35:26:
may those who rejoice in my troubles be totally embarrassed and ashamed.
may those who arrogantly taunt me be covered with shame and humiliation.
Psalm 35:27:
may those who desire my vindication shout for joy and rejoice.
may they continually say, “may the lord be praised, for he wants his servant to be secure.”
Psalm 35:28:
then i will tell others about your justice,
and praise you all day long.
Psalm 36:1:
an evil man is rebellious to the core.
he does not fear god,
Psalm 36:2:
for he is too proud
to recognize and give up his sin.
Psalm 36:3:
the words he speaks are sinful and deceitful;
he does not care about doing what is wise and right.
Psalm 36:5:
o lord, your loyal love reaches to the sky,
your faithfulness to the clouds.
Psalm 36:7:
how precious is your loyal love, o god!
the human race finds shelter under your wings.
Psalm 36:8:
they are filled with food from your house,
and you allow them to drink from the river of your delicacies.
Psalm 36:9:
for with you is the fountain of life;
in your light we see light.
Psalm 36:10:
extend your loyal love to your faithful followers,
and vindicate the morally upright.
Psalm 36:11:
do not let arrogant men overtake me,
or let evil men make me homeless.
Psalm 36:12:
i can see the evildoers! they have fallen.
they have been knocked down and are unable to get up.
Psalm 37:1:
do not fret when wicked men seem to succeed.
do not envy evildoers.
Psalm 37:2:
for they will quickly dry up like grass,
and wither away like plants.
Psalm 37:3:
trust in the lord and do what is right.
settle in the land and maintain your integrity.
Psalm 37:4:
then you will take delight in the lord,
and he will answer your prayers.
Psalm 37:5:
commit your future to the lord.
trust in him, and he will act on your behalf.
Psalm 37:6:
he will vindicate you in broad daylight,
and publicly defend your just cause.
Psalm 37:7:
wait patiently for the lord!
wait confidently for him!
do not fret over the apparent success of a sinner,
a man who carries out wicked schemes.
Psalm 37:8:
do not be angry and frustrated.
do not fret. that only leads to trouble.
Psalm 37:9:
wicked men will be wiped out,
but those who rely on the lord are the ones who will possess the land.
Psalm 37:10:
evil men will soon disappear;
you will stare at the spot where they once were, but they will be gone.
Psalm 37:11:
but the oppressed will possess the land
and enjoy great prosperity.
Psalm 37:12:
evil men plot against the godly
and viciously attack them.
Psalm 37:13:
the lord laughs in disgust at them,
for he knows that their day is coming.
Psalm 37:14:
evil men draw their swords
and prepare their bows,
to bring down the oppressed and needy,
and to slaughter those who are godly.
Psalm 37:15:
their swords will pierce their own hearts,
and their bows will be broken.
Psalm 37:16:
the little bit that a godly man owns is better than
the wealth of many evil men,
Psalm 37:17:
for evil men will lose their power,
but the lord sustains the godly.
Psalm 37:18:
the lord watches over the innocent day by day,
and they possess a permanent inheritance.
Psalm 37:19:
they will not be ashamed when hard times come;
when famine comes they will have enough to eat.
Psalm 37:21:
evil men borrow, but do not repay their debt,
but the godly show compassion and are generous.
Psalm 37:22:
surely those favored by the lord will possess the land,
but those rejected by him will be wiped out.
Psalm 37:23:
the lord grants success to the one
whose behavior he finds commendable.
Psalm 37:24:
even if he trips, he will not fall headlong,
for the lord holds his hand.
Psalm 37:25:
i was once young, now i am old.
i have never seen the godly abandoned,
or their children forced to search for food.
Psalm 37:26:
all day long they show compassion and lend to others,
and their children are blessed.
Psalm 37:27:
turn away from evil. do what is right.
then you will enjoy lasting security.
Psalm 37:28:
for the lord promotes justice,
and never abandons his faithful followers.
they are permanently secure,
but the children of the wicked are wiped out.
Psalm 37:29:
the godly will possess the land
and will dwell in it permanently.
Psalm 37:30:
the godly speak wise words
and promote justice.
Psalm 37:31:
the law of their god controls their thinking;
their feet do not slip.
Psalm 37:32:
the wicked set an ambush for the godly
and try to kill them.
Psalm 37:33:
but the lord does not surrender the godly,
or allow them to be condemned in a court of law.
Psalm 37:35:
i have seen ruthless, wicked people
growing in influence, like a green tree grows in its native soil.
Psalm 37:36:
but then one passes by, and suddenly they have disappeared.
i looked for them, but they could not be found.
Psalm 37:37:
take note of the one who has integrity. observe the upright.
for the one who promotes peace has a future.
Psalm 37:38:
sinful rebels are totally destroyed;
the wicked have no future.
Psalm 37:39:
but the lord delivers the godly;
he protects them in times of trouble.
Psalm 38:1:
o lord, do not continue to rebuke me in your anger.
do not continue to punish me in your raging fury.
Psalm 38:2:
for your arrows pierce me,
and your hand presses me down.
Psalm 38:3:
my whole body is sick because of your judgment;
i am deprived of health because of my sin.
Psalm 38:4:
for my sins overwhelm me;
like a heavy load, they are too much for me to bear.
Psalm 38:5:
my wounds are infected and starting to smell,
because of my foolish sins.
Psalm 38:6:
i am dazed and completely humiliated;
all day long i walk around mourning.
Psalm 38:7:
for i am overcome with shame,
and my whole body is sick.
Psalm 38:8:
i am numb with pain and severely battered;
i groan loudly because of the anxiety i feel.
Psalm 38:9:
o lord, you understand my heart’s desire;
my groaning is not hidden from you.
Psalm 38:11:
because of my condition, even my friends and acquaintances keep their distance;
my neighbors stand far away.
Psalm 38:13:
but i am like a deaf man—i hear nothing;
i am like a mute who cannot speak.
Psalm 38:14:
i am like a man who cannot hear
and is incapable of arguing his defense.
Psalm 38:15:
yet i wait for you, o lord!
you will respond, o lord, my god!
Psalm 38:16:
i have prayed for deliverance, because otherwise they will gloat over me;
when my foot slips they will arrogantly taunt me.
Psalm 38:17:
for i am about to stumble,
and i am in constant pain.
Psalm 38:18:
yes, i confess my wrongdoing,
and i am concerned about my sins.
Psalm 38:19:
but those who are my enemies for no reason are numerous;
those who hate me without cause outnumber me.
Psalm 38:20:
they repay me evil for the good i have done;
though i have tried to do good to them, they hurl accusations at me.
Psalm 38:21:
do not abandon me, o lord.
my god, do not remain far away from me.
Psalm 38:22: hurry and help me, o lord, my deliverer.
Psalm 39:1:
i decided, “i will watch what i say
and make sure i do not sin with my tongue.
i will put a muzzle over my mouth
while in the presence of an evil person.”
Psalm 39:3:
my anxiety intensified.
as i thought about it, i became impatient.
finally i spoke these words:
Psalm 39:4:
“o lord, help me understand my mortality
and the brevity of life.
let me realize how quickly my life will pass.
Psalm 39:5:
look, you make my days short-lived,
and my life span is nothing from your perspective.
surely all people, even those who seem secure, are nothing but vapor. (selah)
Psalm 39:6:
surely people go through life as mere ghosts.
surely they accumulate worthless wealth
without knowing who will eventually haul it away.”
Psalm 39:7:
but now, o lord, upon what am i relying?
you are my only hope!
Psalm 39:8:
deliver me from all my sins of rebellion.
do not make me the object of fools’ insults.
Psalm 39:9:
i am silent and cannot open my mouth
because of what you have done.
Psalm 39:10:
please stop wounding me.
you have almost beaten me to death.
Psalm 39:12:
hear my prayer, o lord.
listen to my cry for help.
do not ignore my sobbing.
for i am a resident foreigner with you,
a temporary settler, just as all my ancestors were.
Psalm 39:13:
turn your angry gaze away from me, so i can be happy
before i pass away.
Psalm 40:1:
i relied completely on the lord,
and he turned toward me
and heard my cry for help.
Psalm 40:2:
he lifted me out of the watery pit,
out of the slimy mud.
he placed my feet on a rock
and gave me secure footing.
Psalm 40:3:
he gave me reason to sing a new song,
praising our god.
may many see what god has done,
so that they might swear allegiance to him and trust in the lord.
Psalm 40:4:
how blessed is the one who trusts in the lord
and does not seek help from the proud or from liars.
Psalm 40:5:
o lord, my god, you have accomplished many things;
you have done amazing things and carried out your purposes for us.
no one can thwart you.
i want to declare your deeds and talk about them,
but they are too numerous to recount.
Psalm 40:6:
receiving sacrifices and offerings are not your primary concern.
you make that quite clear to me.
you do not ask for burnt sacrifices and sin offerings.
Psalm 40:7:
then i say,
“look, i come!
what is written in the scroll pertains to me.
Psalm 40:8:
i want to do what pleases you, my god.
your law dominates my thoughts.”
Psalm 40:9:
i have told the great assembly about your justice.
look, i spare no words.
o lord, you know this is true.
Psalm 40:11:
o lord, you do not withhold your compassion from me.
may your loyal love and faithfulness continually protect me!
Psalm 40:12:
for innumerable dangers surround me.
my sins overtake me
so i am unable to see;
they outnumber the hairs of my head
so my strength fails me.
Psalm 40:13:
please be willing, o lord, to rescue me!
o lord, hurry and help me!
Psalm 40:14:
may those who are trying to snatch away my life
be totally embarrassed and ashamed.
may those who want to harm me
be turned back and ashamed.
Psalm 40:15:
may those who say to me, “aha! aha!”
be humiliated and disgraced.
Psalm 40:16:
may all those who seek you be happy and rejoice in you.
may those who love to experience your deliverance say continually,
“may the lord be praised!”
Psalm 40:17:
i am oppressed and needy.
may the lord pay attention to me.
you are my helper and my deliverer.
o my god, do not delay.
Psalm 41:1:
how blessed is the one who treats the poor properly.
when trouble comes, may the lord deliver him.
Psalm 41:2:
may the lord protect him and save his life.
may he be blessed in the land.
do not turn him over to his enemies.
Psalm 41:3:
the lord supports him on his sickbed;
you have healed him from his illness.
Psalm 41:4:
as for me, i said:
“o lord, have mercy on me!
heal me, for i have sinned against you.
Psalm 41:5:
my enemies ask this cruel question about me,
‘when will he finally die and be forgotten?’
Psalm 41:7:
all who hate me whisper insults about me to one another;
they plan ways to harm me.
Psalm 41:8:
they say,
‘an awful disease overwhelms him,
and now that he is bedridden he will never recover.’
Psalm 41:9:
even my close friend whom i trusted,
he who shared meals with me, has turned against me.
Psalm 41:10:
as for you, o lord, have mercy on me and raise me up,
so i can pay them back!”
Psalm 41:11:
by this i know that you are pleased with me,
for my enemy does not triumph over me.
Psalm 41:12:
as for me, you uphold me because of my integrity;
you allow me permanent access to your presence.
Psalm 41:13:
the lord god of israel deserves praise
in the future and forevermore.
we agree! we agree!
Psalm 42:1:
as a deer longs for streams of water,
so i long for you, o god!
Psalm 42:2:
i thirst for god,
for the living god.
i say, “when will i be able to go and appear in god’s presence?”
Psalm 42:3:
i cannot eat; i weep day and night.
all day long they say to me, “where is your god?”
Psalm 42:5:
why are you depressed, o my soul?
why are you upset?
wait for god!
for i will again give thanks
to my god for his saving intervention.
Psalm 42:6:
i am depressed,
so i will pray to you while in the region of the upper jordan,
from hermon, from mount mizar.
Psalm 42:7:
one deep stream calls out to another at the sound of your waterfalls;
all your billows and waves overwhelm me.
Psalm 42:8:
by day the lord decrees his loyal love,
and by night he gives me a song,
a prayer to the god of my life.
Psalm 42:9:
i will pray to god, my high ridge:
“why do you ignore me?
why must i walk around mourning
because my enemies oppress me?”
Psalm 42:10:
my enemies’ taunts cut me to the bone,
as they say to me all day long, “where is your god?”
Psalm 42:11:
why are you depressed, o my soul?
why are you upset?
wait for god!
for i will again give thanks
to my god for his saving intervention.
Psalm 43:1:
vindicate me, o god!
fight for me against an ungodly nation.
deliver me from deceitful and evil men.
Psalm 43:2:
for you are the god who shelters me.
why do you reject me?
why must i walk around mourning
because my enemies oppress me?
Psalm 43:3:
reveal your light and your faithfulness.
they will lead me;
they will escort me back to your holy hill,
and to the place where you live.
Psalm 43:4:
then i will go to the altar of god,
to the god who gives me ecstatic joy,
so that i may express my thanks to you, o god, my god, with a harp.
Psalm 43:5:
why are you depressed, o my soul?
why are you upset?
wait for god!
for i will again give thanks
to my god for his saving intervention.
Psalm 44:1:
o god, we have clearly heard;
our ancestors have told us
what you did in their days,
in ancient times.
Psalm 44:2:
you, by your power, defeated nations and settled our fathers on their land;
you crushed the people living there and enabled our ancestors to occupy it.
Psalm 44:3:
for they did not conquer the land by their swords,
and they did not prevail by their strength,
but rather by your power, strength, and good favor,
for you were partial to them.
Psalm 44:4:
you are my king, o god.
decree jacob’s deliverance.
Psalm 44:5:
by your power we will drive back our enemies;
by your strength we will trample down our foes.
Psalm 44:6:
for i do not trust in my bow,
and i do not prevail by my sword.
Psalm 44:7:
for you deliver us from our enemies;
you humiliate those who hate us.
Psalm 44:8:
in god we boast all day long,
and we will continually give thanks to your name. (selah)
Psalm 44:9:
but you rejected and embarrassed us.
you did not go into battle with our armies.
Psalm 44:10:
you made us retreat from the enemy.
those who hate us take whatever they want from us.
Psalm 44:11:
you handed us over like sheep to be eaten;
you scattered us among the nations.
Psalm 44:12:
you sold your people for a pittance;
you did not ask a high price for them.
Psalm 44:13:
you made us an object of disdain to our neighbors;
those who live on our borders taunt and insult us.
Psalm 44:14:
you made us an object of ridicule among the nations;
foreigners treat us with contempt.
Psalm 44:15:
all day long i feel humiliated
and am overwhelmed with shame,
Psalm 44:16:
before the vindictive enemy
who ridicules and insults me.
Psalm 44:17:
all this has happened to us, even though we have not rejected you
or violated your covenant with us.
Psalm 44:18:
we have not been unfaithful,
nor have we disobeyed your commands.
Psalm 44:19:
yet you have battered us, leaving us a heap of ruins overrun by wild dogs;
you have covered us with darkness.
Psalm 44:20:
if we had rejected our god,
and spread out our hands in prayer to another god,
Psalm 44:21:
would not god discover it,
for he knows a person’s secret thoughts?
Psalm 44:22:
yet because of you we are killed all day long;
we are treated like sheep at the slaughtering block.
Psalm 44:23:
rouse yourself! why do you sleep, o lord?
wake up! do not reject us forever.
Psalm 44:24:
why do you look the other way,
and ignore the way we are oppressed and mistreated?
Psalm 44:25:
for we lie in the dirt,
with our bellies pressed to the ground.
Psalm 44:26:
rise up and help us.
rescue us because of your loyal love.
Psalm 45:2:
you are the most handsome of all men.
you speak in an impressive and fitting manner.
for this reason god grants you continual blessings.
Psalm 45:3:
strap your sword to your thigh, o warrior.
appear in your majestic splendor.
Psalm 45:4:
appear in your majesty and be victorious.
ride forth for the sake of what is right,
on behalf of justice.
then your right hand will accomplish mighty acts.
Psalm 45:5:
your arrows are sharp
and penetrate the hearts of the king’s enemies.
nations fall at your feet.
Psalm 45:6:
your throne, o god, is permanent.
the scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of justice.
Psalm 45:7:
you love justice and hate evil.
for this reason god, your god, has anointed you
with the oil of joy, elevating you above your companions.
Psalm 45:8:
all your garments are perfumed with myrrh, aloes, and cassia.
from the luxurious palaces comes the music of stringed instruments that makes you happy.
Psalm 45:9:
princesses are among your honored women.
your bride stands at your right hand, wearing jewelry made with gold from ophir.
Psalm 45:10:
listen, o princess.
observe and pay attention!
forget your homeland and your family.
Psalm 45:11:
then the king will be attracted by your beauty.
after all, he is your master. submit to him.
Psalm 45:12:
rich people from tyre
will seek your favor by bringing a gift.
Psalm 45:13:
the princess looks absolutely magnificent,
decked out in pearls and clothed in a brocade trimmed with gold.
Psalm 45:14:
in embroidered robes she is escorted to the king.
her attendants, the maidens of honor who follow her,
are led before you.
Psalm 45:15:
they are bubbling with joy as they walk in procession
and enter the royal palace.
Psalm 45:16:
your sons will carry on the dynasty of your ancestors;
you will make them princes throughout the land.
Psalm 45:17:
i will proclaim your greatness through the coming years,
then the nations will praise you forever.
Psalm 46:1:
god is our strong refuge;
he is truly our helper in times of trouble.
Psalm 46:2:
for this reason we do not fear when the earth shakes,
and the mountains tumble into the depths of the sea,
Psalm 46:3:
when its waves crash and foam,
and the mountains shake before the surging sea. (selah)
Psalm 46:4:
the river’s channels bring joy to the city of god,
the special, holy dwelling place of the most high.
Psalm 46:5:
god lives within it, it cannot be moved.
god rescues it at the break of dawn.
Psalm 46:6:
nations are in uproar, kingdoms are overthrown.
god gives a shout, the earth dissolves.
Psalm 46:7:
the lord of heaven’s armies is on our side.
the god of jacob is our stronghold. (selah)
Psalm 46:8:
come, witness the exploits of the lord,
who brings devastation to the earth.
Psalm 46:10:
he says, “stop your striving and recognize that i am god.
i will be exalted over the nations! i will be exalted over the earth!”
Psalm 46:11:
the lord of heaven’s armies is on our side!
the god of jacob is our stronghold! (selah)
Psalm 47:1:
all you nations, clap your hands.
shout out to god in celebration.
Psalm 47:2:
for the lord most high is awe-inspiring;
he is the great king who rules the whole earth!
Psalm 47:3:
he subdued nations beneath us
and countries under our feet.
Psalm 47:4:
he picked out for us a special land
to be a source of pride for jacob, whom he loves. (selah)
Psalm 47:5:
god has ascended his throne amid loud shouts;
the lord has ascended amid the blaring of ram’s horns.
Psalm 47:6:
sing to god! sing!
sing to our king! sing!
Psalm 47:7:
for god is king of the whole earth.
sing a well-written song.
Psalm 47:8:
god reigns over the nations.
god sits on his holy throne.
Psalm 47:9:
the nobles of the nations assemble,
along with the people of the god of abraham,
for god has authority over the rulers of the earth.
he is highly exalted.
Psalm 48:1:
the lord is great and certainly worthy of praise
in the city of our god, his holy hill.
Psalm 48:2:
it is lofty and pleasing to look at,
a source of joy to the whole earth.
mount zion resembles the peaks of zaphon;
it is the city of the great king.
Psalm 48:3:
god is in its fortresses;
he reveals himself as its defender.
Psalm 48:4:
for look, the kings assemble;
they advance together.
Psalm 48:5:
as soon as they see, they are shocked;
they are terrified, they quickly retreat.
Psalm 48:6:
look at them shake uncontrollably,
like a woman writhing in childbirth.
Psalm 48:7:
with an east wind
you shatter the large ships.
Psalm 48:8:
we heard about god’s mighty deeds; now we have seen them,
in the city of the lord of heaven’s armies,
in the city of our god.
god makes it permanently secure. (selah)
Psalm 48:9:
within your temple
we reflect on your loyal love, o god.
Psalm 48:10:
the praise you receive as far away as the ends of the earth
is worthy of your reputation, o god.
you execute justice.
Psalm 48:12:
walk around zion. encircle it.
count its towers.
Psalm 48:13:
consider its defenses.
walk through its fortresses,
so you can tell the next generation about it.
Psalm 48:14:
for god, our god, is our defender forever.
he guides us.
Psalm 49:1:
listen to this, all you nations.
pay attention, all you inhabitants of the world.
Psalm 49:2:
pay attention, all you people,
both rich and poor.
Psalm 49:3:
i will declare a wise saying;
i will share my profound thoughts.
Psalm 49:4:
i will learn a song that imparts wisdom;
i will then sing my insightful song to the accompaniment of a harp.
Psalm 49:5:
why should i be afraid in times of trouble,
when the sinful deeds of deceptive men threaten to overwhelm me?
Psalm 49:6:
they trust in their wealth
and boast in their great riches.
Psalm 49:7:
certainly a man cannot rescue his brother;
he cannot pay god an adequate ransom price
Psalm 49:8:
(the ransom price for a human life is too high,
and people go to their final destiny),
Psalm 49:9:
so that he might continue to live forever
and not experience death.
Psalm 49:11:
their grave becomes their permanent residence,
their eternal dwelling place.
they name their lands after themselves,
Psalm 49:12:
but, despite their wealth, people do not last.
they are like animals that perish.
Psalm 49:13:
this is the destiny of fools,
and of those who approve of their philosophy. (selah)
Psalm 49:14:
they will travel to sheol like sheep,
with death as their shepherd.
the godly will rule over them when the day of vindication dawns.
sheol will consume their bodies, and they will no longer live in impressive houses.
Psalm 49:15:
but god will rescue my life from the power of sheol;
certainly he will pull me to safety. (selah)
Psalm 49:16:
do not be afraid when a man becomes rich
and his wealth multiplies.
Psalm 49:17:
for he will take nothing with him when he dies;
his wealth will not follow him down into the grave.
Psalm 49:18:
he pronounces this blessing on himself while he is alive:
“may men praise you, for you have done well.”
Psalm 49:19:
but he will join his ancestors;
they will never again see the light of day.
Psalm 49:20:
wealthy people do not understand;
they are like animals that perish.
Psalm 50:1:
el, god, the lord has spoken,
and summoned the earth to come from the east and west.
Psalm 50:2:
from zion, the most beautiful of all places,
god has come in splendor.
Psalm 50:3:
“may our god come
and not be silent.”
consuming fire goes ahead of him,
and all around him a storm rages.
Psalm 50:4:
he summons the heavens above,
as well as the earth, so that he might judge his people.
Psalm 50:5:
he says:
“assemble my covenant people before me,
those who ratified a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
Psalm 50:6:
the heavens declare his fairness,
for god is judge. (selah)
Psalm 50:7:
he says:
“listen, my people. i am speaking!
listen, israel. i am accusing you.
i am god, your god!
Psalm 50:8:
i am not condemning you because of your sacrifices,
or because of your burnt sacrifices that you continually offer me.
Psalm 50:9:
i do not need to take a bull from your household
or goats from your sheepfolds.
Psalm 50:10:
for every wild animal in the forest belongs to me,
as well as the cattle that graze on a thousand hills.
Psalm 50:11:
i keep track of every bird in the hills,
and the insects of the field are mine.
Psalm 50:12:
even if i were hungry, i would not tell you,
for the world and all it contains belong to me.
Psalm 50:13:
do i eat the flesh of bulls?
do i drink the blood of goats?
Psalm 50:14:
present to god a thank offering.
repay your vows to the most high.
Psalm 50:15:
pray to me when you are in trouble.
i will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
Psalm 50:16:
god says this to the evildoer:
“how can you declare my commands,
and talk about my covenant?
Psalm 50:17:
for you hate instruction
and reject my words.
Psalm 50:18:
when you see a thief, you join him;
you associate with men who are unfaithful to their wives.
Psalm 50:19:
you do damage with words,
and use your tongue to deceive.
Psalm 50:20:
you plot against your brother;
you slander your own brother.
Psalm 50:21:
when you did these things, i was silent,
so you thought i was exactly like you.
but now i will condemn you
and state my case against you.
Psalm 50:22:
carefully consider this, you who reject god.
otherwise i will rip you to shreds
and no one will be able to rescue you.
Psalm 50:23:
whoever presents a thank offering honors me.
to whoever obeys my commands, i will reveal my power to deliver.”
Psalm 51:1:
have mercy on me, o god, because of your loyal love.
because of your great compassion, wipe away my rebellious acts.
Psalm 51:2:
wash away my wrongdoing.
cleanse me of my sin.
Psalm 51:3:
for i am aware of my rebellious acts;
i am forever conscious of my sin.
Psalm 51:5:
look, i was guilty of sin from birth,
a sinner the moment my mother conceived me.
Psalm 51:6:
look, you desire integrity in the inner man;
you want me to possess wisdom.
Psalm 51:7:
cleanse me with hyssop and i will be pure;
wash me and i will be whiter than snow.
Psalm 51:8:
grant me the ultimate joy of being forgiven.
may the bones you crushed rejoice.
Psalm 51:9:
hide your face from my sins.
wipe away all my guilt.
Psalm 51:10:
create for me a pure heart, o god.
renew a resolute spirit within me.
Psalm 51:11:
do not reject me.
do not take your holy spirit away from me.
Psalm 51:12:
let me again experience the joy of your deliverance.
sustain me by giving me the desire to obey.
Psalm 51:13:
then i will teach rebels your merciful ways,
and sinners will turn to you.
Psalm 51:14:
rescue me from the guilt of murder, o god, the god who delivers me.
then my tongue will shout for joy because of your righteousness.
Psalm 51:15:
o lord, give me the words.
then my mouth will praise you.
Psalm 51:16:
certainly you do not want a sacrifice, or else i would offer it;
you do not desire a burnt sacrifice.
Psalm 51:17:
the sacrifice god desires is a humble spirit—
o god, a humble and repentant heart you will not reject.
Psalm 51:18:
because you favor zion, do what is good for her.
fortify the walls of jerusalem.
Psalm 51:19:
then you will accept the proper sacrifices, burnt sacrifices and whole offerings;
then bulls will be sacrificed on your altar.
Psalm 52:1:
why do you boast about your evil plans, o powerful man?
god’s loyal love protects me all day long.
Psalm 52:2:
your tongue carries out your destructive plans;
it is as effective as a sharp razor, o deceiver.
Psalm 52:3:
you love evil more than good,
lies more than speaking the truth. (selah)
Psalm 52:4:
you love to use all the words that destroy,
and the tongue that deceives.
Psalm 52:6:
when the godly see this, they will be filled with awe,
and will mock the evildoer, saying:
Psalm 52:7:
“look, here is the man who would not make god his protector.
he trusted in his great wealth
and was confident about his plans to destroy others.”
Psalm 52:8:
but i am like a flourishing olive tree in the house of god;
i continually trust in god’s loyal love.
Psalm 52:9:
i will continually thank you when you execute judgment;
i will rely on you, for your loyal followers know you are good.
Psalm 53:2:
god looks down from heaven at the human race,
to see if there is anyone who is wise and seeks god.
Psalm 53:3:
everyone rejects god;
they are all morally corrupt.
none of them does what is right,
not even one!
Psalm 53:4:
all those who behave wickedly do not understand—
those who devour my people as if they were eating bread,
and do not call out to god.
Psalm 53:5:
they are absolutely terrified,
even by things that do not normally cause fear.
for god annihilates those who attack you.
you are able to humiliate them because god has rejected them.
Psalm 53:6:
i wish the deliverance of israel would come from zion!
when god restores the well-being of his people,
may jacob rejoice,
may israel be happy!
Psalm 54:1:
o god, deliver me by your name.
vindicate me by your power.
Psalm 54:2:
o god, listen to my prayer.
pay attention to what i say.
Psalm 54:3:
for foreigners attack me;
ruthless men, who do not respect god, seek my life. (selah)
Psalm 54:4:
look, god is my deliverer.
the lord is among those who support me.
Psalm 54:5:
may those who wait to ambush me be repaid for their evil.
as a demonstration of your faithfulness, destroy them.
Psalm 54:6:
with a freewill offering i will sacrifice to you.
i will give thanks to your name, o lord, for it is good.
Psalm 54:7:
surely he rescues me from all trouble,
and i triumph over my enemies.
Psalm 55:1:
listen, o god, to my prayer.
do not ignore my appeal for mercy.
Psalm 55:2:
pay attention to me and answer me.
i am so upset and distressed, i am beside myself,
Psalm 55:3:
because of what the enemy says,
and because of how the wicked pressure me,
for they hurl trouble down upon me
and angrily attack me.
Psalm 55:4:
my heart beats violently within me;
the horrors of death overcome me.
Psalm 55:5:
fear and panic overpower me;
terror overwhelms me.
Psalm 55:6:

disaster is within it;

Psalm 56:3:
when i am afraid,

Psalm 56:4:
in god—i boast in his promise—

Psalm 56:5:

because they are bent on violence, do not let them escape.

Psalm 56:9:

Psalm 56:10:
in god—i boast in his promise—

in god i trust; i am not afraid.
what can mere men do to me?
Psalm 56:12:

Psalm 57:1:

rise up above the sky, o god.

awake, my soul!

Psalm 57:9:

Psalm 57:10:

Psalm 57:11:
rise up above the sky, o god.
may your splendor cover the whole earth.
Psalm 58:1:

before the kindling is even placed under your pots,

deliver me from evildoers.
rescue me from violent men.

Psalm 59:10:
the god who loves me will help me;

Psalm 59:17:

Psalm 60:1:

Psalm 60:2:

by god’s power we will conquer;

Psalm 61:1:
o god, hear my cry for help.
pay attention to my prayer.

from the remotest place on earth

lead me up to a rocky summit where i can be safe.
Psalm 61:3:
indeed, you are my shelter,

Psalm 61:4:
i will be a permanent guest in your home;

for you, o god, hear my vows;

Psalm 62:1:

he alone is my protector and deliverer.

Psalm 119:174:
i long for your deliverance, o lord;
i find delight in your law.
Psalm 119:175:
may i live and praise you.
may your regulations help me.
Psalm 119:176:
i have wandered off like a lost sheep.
come looking for your servant,
for i do not forget your commands.
Psalm 120:1:
in my distress i cried out
to the lord and he answered me.
Psalm 120:2:
i said, “o lord, rescue me
from those who lie with their lips
and those who deceive with their tongues.
Psalm 120:3:
how will he severely punish you,
you deceptive talker?
Psalm 120:4:
here’s how! with the sharp arrows of warriors,
with arrowheads forged over the hot coals.
Psalm 120:6:
for too long i have had to reside
with those who hate peace.
Psalm 120:7:
i am committed to peace,
but when i speak, they want to make war.
Psalm 121:1:
i look up toward the hills.
from where does my help come?
Psalm 121:2:
my help comes from the lord,
the creator of heaven and earth.
Psalm 121:3:
may he not allow your foot to slip.
may your protector not sleep.
Psalm 121:4:
look! israel’s protector
does not sleep or slumber.
Psalm 121:5:
the lord is your protector;
the lord is the shade at your right hand.
Psalm 121:6:
the sun will not harm you by day,
or the moon by night.
Psalm 121:7:
the lord will protect you from all harm;
he will protect your life.
Psalm 121:8:
the lord will protect you in all you do,
now and forevermore.
Psalm 122:1:
i was glad because they said to me,
“we will go to the lord’s temple.”
Psalm 122:2:
our feet are standing
inside your gates, o jerusalem.
Psalm 122:3:
jerusalem is a city designed
to accommodate an assembly.
Psalm 122:4:
the tribes go up there,
the tribes of the lord,
where it is required that israel
give thanks to the name of the lord.
Psalm 122:5:
indeed, the leaders sit there on thrones and make legal decisions,
on the thrones of the house of david.
Psalm 122:6:
pray for the peace of jerusalem.
may those who love her prosper.
Psalm 122:7:
may there be peace inside your defenses,
and prosperity inside your fortresses.
Psalm 122:8:
for the sake of my brothers and my neighbors
i will say, “may there be peace in you.”
Psalm 122:9:
for the sake of the temple of the lord our god
i will pray for you to prosper.
Psalm 123:1:
i look up toward you,
the one enthroned in heaven.
Psalm 123:2:
look, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master,
as the eyes of a female servant look to the hand of her mistress,
so our eyes will look to the lord, our god, until he shows us favor.
Psalm 123:3:
show us favor, o lord, show us favor!
for we have had our fill of humiliation, and then some.
Psalm 123:4:
we have had our fill
of the taunts of the self-assured,
of the contempt of the proud.
Psalm 124:1:
“if the lord had not been on our side”—
let israel say this.—
Psalm 124:2:
if the lord had not been on our side,
when men attacked us,
Psalm 124:3:
they would have swallowed us alive,
when their anger raged against us.
Psalm 124:4:
the water would have overpowered us;
the current would have overwhelmed us.
Psalm 124:5:
the raging water
would have overwhelmed us.
Psalm 124:6:
the lord deserves praise,
for he did not hand us over as prey to their teeth.
Psalm 124:7:
we escaped with our lives, like a bird from a hunter’s snare.
the snare broke, and we escaped.
Psalm 124:8:
our deliverer is the lord,
the creator of heaven and earth.
Psalm 125:1:
those who trust in the lord are like mount zion,
which cannot be moved and will endure forever.
Psalm 125:2:
as the mountains surround jerusalem,
so the lord surrounds his people,
now and forevermore.
Psalm 125:3:
indeed, the scepter of a wicked king will not settle
upon the allotted land of the godly.
otherwise the godly
might do what is wrong.
Psalm 125:4:
do good, o lord, to those who are good,
to the morally upright.
Psalm 125:5:
as for those who are bent on traveling a sinful path,
may the lord remove them, along with those who behave wickedly.
may israel experience peace.
Psalm 126:1:
when the lord restored the well-being of zion,
we thought we were dreaming.
Psalm 126:2:
at that time we laughed loudly
and shouted for joy.
at that time the nations said,
“the lord has accomplished great things for these people.”
Psalm 126:3:
the lord did indeed accomplish great things for us.
we were happy.
Psalm 126:4:
o lord, restore our well-being,
just as the streams in the arid south are replenished.
Psalm 126:5:
those who shed tears as they plant
will shout for joy when they reap the harvest.
Psalm 126:6:
the one who weeps as he walks along, carrying his bag of seed,
will certainly come in with a shout of joy, carrying his sheaves of grain.
Psalm 127:2:
it is vain for you to rise early, come home late,
and work so hard for your food.
